behavior: dotf secrets unlock prompts for the master password with echo disabled, starts bw serve if needed, and unlocks via POST /unlock without the password ever appearing in shell history, process args, or disk
With the daemon running and unlocked, dotf secrets verify over the current registry completes in under 2 seconds
With no daemon running, every existing dotf secrets command behaves exactly as it does today (CLI shellout fallback)
dotf doctor reports the bw serve daemon's state (absent/locked/unlocked) as a distinct check
dotf secrets lock locks the daemon explicitly; dotf secrets unlock run twice while already unlocked is idempotent
